tasks_completed.description: Added fetch_images_with_retry helper function before Step 1 block
tasks_completed.changes: Inserted reusable bash function at line 80 (before Step 1). Function: (a) runs fetch-images-batch.py with stderr suppressed, captures exit code explicitly via '|| exit_code=$?' to satisfy set -euo pipefail; (b) on first failure, prints yellow warning, sleeps 2s, retries with stderr surfaced; (c) on second failure, sets IMAGE_FETCH_STATUS=FAILED and prints a RED multi-line banner containing 'WARNING' and 'FAILED'; (d) always returns 0 so the pipeline continues.
tasks_completed.rationale: Root cause: all three call sites used '|| echo' to silently swallow non-zero exit codes. The fix adds visibility without blocking the deploy.

tasks_completed.description: Replaced three '|| echo' patterns with calls to fetch_images_with_retry
tasks_completed.changes: Line 93 (was): python ... 2>/dev/null || echo ... -> fetch_images_with_retry "$PLAN_ID" 100 10 $FETCH_FORCE $FETCH_DAY_FILTER. Line 101 (was): python ... 2>/dev/null || echo ... -> fetch_images_with_retry "$PLAN_ID" 100 10 $FETCH_FORCE $FETCH_DAY_FILTER. Line 104 (was): python ... 2>/dev/null || echo ... -> fetch_images_with_retry "$PLAN_ID" 100 300. All argument combinations are preserved faithfully.
tasks_completed.rationale: Each call site now has identical retry-and-warn semantics. No call site silently ignores failure.

tasks_completed.changes: Added IMAGE_FETCH_STATUS="OK" at line 114 (before the Step 1 echo). Set to "FAILED" inside the helper on double failure. Available for use in final summary or by callers.
tasks_completed.rationale: Allows downstream steps or the operator to query whether image fetch degradation occurred.

blast_radius.notes: Script is invoked directly by operators and referenced in docs/READMEs and .claude/commands. No shell callers source it or depend on its internal exit-code behaviour. Low blast radius.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A - pattern present from initial script authorship (visible since at least 74d3527)
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: The '|| echo' pattern was an intentional but overly silent bypass of set -euo pipefail to keep images optional. It made fetch failures indistinguishable from successes in the log.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: The helper function preserves the 'images are optional' invariant (always returns 0) while replacing the silent bypass with a retry + loud RED banner on double failure, making degradation unmissable in any terminal or CI log.

dev.tdd_note: TDD skipped: the failure path requires a deliberately broken fetch-images-batch.py or unavailable API endpoint. This is a black-box integration path not reproducible programmatically in the test suite. BA/PM validation approach (run with broken plan ID) is the correct verification method per BA spec.
dev.qa_notes: To verify AC1+AC2+AC3: temporarily prepend 'exit 1' to fetch-images-batch.py (or pass a nonexistent plan ID), run 'bash scripts/generate-and-deploy.sh <any-plan-id>'. Expect: (1) two Python invocations in the log, (2) RED banner with WARNING/FAILED, (3) Steps 2-5 continue. To verify AC4: run with a valid plan that has >50 cached POIs and no --force; expect no retry and no warning. Confirm IMAGE_FETCH_STATUS variable is accessible if needed for summary output.

recommendations: Consider printing IMAGE_FETCH_STATUS in the Step 5 summary section so operators see the degradation indicator at the very end of the log alongside the deployed URL.
If a CI/CD wrapper script checks the exit code of generate-and-deploy.sh, IMAGE_FETCH_STATUS could be used to set a non-zero final exit code if degraded output is unacceptable in that context.
